never_blend_note: Known-absent items have an empty gold set and miss by construction; blending them into recall deflates the headline with guaranteed misses (BENCH-1). Their arm is reported through its size and top-score distribution only. block-P@1 covers the VARM-1 text_answerable passage-scored arm; vision_derived items keep their own denominator in the raw per-fixture JSON and are never blended in here.

combined_table.scoring_rule: top-10 truncation; sparse_mode=fused (hybrid_dense_weight=0.7 -- zeroes a score contribution, does not remove that arm's candidates from the fused pool, see module docstring); paper-level hit = first rank r <= 10 with result.paper_id in question.gold_paper_ids; passage-level hit = first rank r <= 10 with result.anchor.block_id == question.gold_block_id; chapter-level hit = first retrieve_papers rank with paper_id in gold_paper_ids and chapter == gold_chapter_title

block_p_at_1.definition: text-answerable passage-scored items whose gold block ranks exactly 1
